page.layout: One page of a table in three columns: left column of chapter and verse references (Cap. / Vers.), running head at top left, with a heading "Loci" continuing off the right edge. Page cut at the right; only the left part is shown.; One column of right-aligned page references under a running head fragment "orum" and column heading "Pag."; no text blocks beside it.; One printed page, cut at the right: a table of columns (Cap. | Vers. | Pag.) with a running title at the top, Roman-numeral chapter markers down the left, and page number at the foot. Only the left part of the columns is visible.; One column of a printed table, right part of the page, with its page-number column at the right. Its left-hand columns are cut off on this scan.
page.notes: Cut-off right side: page numbers and further columns beyond the left edge are not visible. Some entries at the right edge of the visible area (e.g. "2", "3", "1") are partly cropped and may belong to the page-number column; reading of the faint marks after "13.14", "15" and "27" is uncertain. The left edge of the entries is cut off, so the first digits of some numbers are missing or uncertain (e.g. "34,348", "41,706", "0,1230", "1,1178" may be truncated). Digits in the printed page numbers are read as shown. Right part of the table is cut off; many figures are only partly visible. Chapter markers are Roman numerals in the left column. The page number reads Oooo 5 at the foot. Partial numerals are transcribed as far as they show. Left-hand columns are cut off, so only the fragments visible at the left edge are given. Digits such as "o" for 20 and "9" for 19 are partial numerals as far as they can be read.
